pages.text: Each tier is unlocked by a different heart. Without the right heart you cannot craft or upgrade any piece of that tier.
$(b)Heart Of The Fallen$(): rarely dropped by Zombies and Skeletons, and much more often by Wither Skeletons.$(br2)$(b)Heart Of The Ghosts$(): dropped by Phantoms, Ghasts and Vexes.
$(b)Heart Of The Elite$(): dropped by Elder Guardians half the time, and guaranteed from the Wither, the Warden and the Ender Dragon.
